matchedEvidence.methodology: Keyboard activation of real production UI controls. Event completion requires two requestAnimationFrame callbacks after the latest root DOM mutation; generation guards cancel earlier callbacks. Conversion additionally waits for committed graph card. AppCore/Viz render-function durations and named production operations recorded independently. Instrumented development/StrictMode; paint opportunity proxy, not compositor completion. Three matched reload sessions per fixture; baseline/candidate ordering AB, BA, AB. No background test/build load during final measurement.

automationLimitations.diagnosis: Document-wide text query timed out on B5 while narrow input/status selectors and real searches succeeded on the same graph. Coordinate hit-testing failures also occurred on baseline and candidate Dynamic controls in exploratory evidence. Narrow selectors, upload-read completion guards and keyboard activation completed the matched and uninstrumented production workflows. Selector/hit-test deadlines are automation durations, not application latency.

harnessFailures.reason: File chooser completion preceded asynchronous file read. Convert was activated with empty input; no graph committed. Corrected harness waits for Loaded notice and verifies exact input length before conversion.
Tools tab handles Enter in keydown, so click-only observer missed the valid activation. Added Enter/Space keydown observation to temporary probe and repeated complete matched Dynamic sessions.

paintLimitations: Double requestAnimationFrame after the latest observed root DOM mutation is a paint-opportunity/settle proxy, not a compositor/GPU completion measurement. Matched runs use instrumented development builds with StrictMode; final uninstrumented production checks validate behavior. Three ordinary sessions per fixture, three Dynamic sessions per phase: descriptive median/p95 only (n=3 p95 equals max), no statistical browser SLO claim. Named function timings are inclusive and nested; do not sum them with render function timings. Capture listener microtask handlerTaskMs is not a reliable complete React handler measurement and is not used.
